newsitem.title: UK: IPE Brent futures slip back on technical failure.
newsitem.headline: IPE Brent futures slip back on technical failure.

text.p: IPE Brent crude oil futures slipped lower in early trading on Friday on a continuation of Thursday's sell-off, brokers said.
March Brent was traded five cents lower at $22.37 a barrel at 1100 GMT, while February gas oil was down $4.75 a tonne at $203.25.

"The market failed dismally yesterday on a technical move as it tried to go higher and there wasn't enough volume around to push it through, and I'd expect the sell-off to continue today," one broker said.
Dealers said the market was returning to the bearish trend of the last few days, after Thursday's initial pick-up on the back of the week's bullish U.S. stocks data.
They said volumes were thin and with a lack of market-moving news prices were likely to remain rangebound and test the bottom end of the $22.29/31 to $22.94 channel.
